info.title: API.SH: Heureka
info.description: The Heureka API from API.SH: public Heureka data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Heureka category listing with every filter
get.description:
A Heureka category (or section) by slug or link: the category (name, breadcrumbs, product and review counts, page title and description), its products and product lines (same fields as search), every filter group of the category with option ids and counts, sub-categories, guides and quick filters (`filter_string`). Filter with `filters`, `price_min`/`price_max`, a quick filter's `filter_string` or `q`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/heureka-category

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: A category slug (mobilni-telefony) or link (https://mobilni-telefony.heureka.cz/).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Heureka.cz or Heureka.sk (Slovak slugs differ, e.g. mobilne-telefony).

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Filters as `filterId:optionId|optionId;filterId:optionId`, from the answer's `filters` (each option has a ready `param`), e.g. `1666:2|5;availability:1`. Stock (availability), rating (review), price bands and price drops work the same way.

parameters.name: filter_string
parameters.description: A quick filter's `filter_string` from `related`, e.g. f:d:1 (price drops).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords within the category.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (24 results per page).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Heureka shop offers for a product
get.description:
The shops selling a Heureka product: on page 1 the top offer, promoted and highlighted offers, then the regular offers (20 per page) with price, cheapest delivery, discount, availability and delivery date, Heureka cart, variants, pickup points, offer link and the shop (name, link, logo, rating, review count, recommendation share, customer verification, Shop of the Year, badges). Sort and filter like the page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/heureka-offers

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Heureka product link (https://mobilni-telefony.heureka.cz/apple-iphone-16-128gb-black/); links from search and category results work.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Instead of `url`: the link's subdomain (e.g. mobilni-telefony).

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Instead of `url`: the link's path (e.g. apple-iphone-16-128gb-black).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: With category and slug: Heureka.cz or Heureka.sk (a link sets it itself).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the regular offers.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Comma-separated: in_stock, free_shipping, cart (buy on Heureka), verified_by_customers, card (card payment), authorized_sellers, sustainable_shop.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Only shops with pickup or delivery in this place, e.g. Praha.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (20 offers per page).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Heureka.cz or Heureka.sk product: name, lowest and highest price, price drops, top badge, producers, category and breadcrumbs, short and full description, highlight blocks, photos, videos, energy labels, every specification grouped as on the page, the product line's variant parameters (colour, memory...) with each variant's link and lowest price, and the review summary (rating, counts, stars, recommendations, pros and cons keywords and the written summary). Shop offers, all reviews and the price history have their own endpoints.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/heureka-product

get.description:
Reviews of a Heureka product. type=all is the page's own mix (customer, expert and translated foreign reviews); type=customer lists customer reviews by filter (verified, positive or negative) with rating, recommendation, pros, cons, summary, verified purchase, date, the reviewer's first name and initial (`author`) and name as the page shows it (`author_name`), the shop it was bought at, photos and the shop's or producer's reply; type=expert lists expert articles or videos (title, extract, link, date). Page 1 also carries the review summary. 10 per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/heureka-reviews

get.summary: Heureka product search (Czech Republic and Slovakia)
get.description:
Search Heureka.cz or Heureka.sk: products and product lines with the lowest and highest price across shops, number of shops and offers, rating (percent) and review count, category, key specifications, energy label, variants with their own lowest price, badges, image, link and `raw`. The answer lists every filter group with option ids and counts (pass them back in `filters`), related categories and guides, and a corrected query when the site corrects it. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/heureka-search

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
